ai.permission.provider_manage: Set up AI providers, models and default routing
ai.permission.routing_manage: Choose which AI models serve this hotel
ai.setting.external_providers_allowed: AI providers outside the installation that may be used at all
ai.setting.external_providers_enabled: Allow AI providers outside the installation for this hotel group
ai.setting.budget_monthly_limit_minor: Monthly limit for AI providers outside the installation (minor currency units)
ai.approval.ai_action: An action proposed by the AI assistant
ai.permission.execution_read: See what the AI assistant did and why
ai.permission.evaluation_read: See AI evaluation sets, runs and releases
ai.permission.evaluation_manage: Write AI evaluation cases and run evaluations
ai.permission.agent_release: Release a new AI assistant version once its evaluation passed
ai.permission.twin_read: See the operational twin: how rooms, stays, work and equipment are connected
ai.setting.evaluation_min_pass_rate: Share of evaluation cases a new AI assistant version must pass before it can be released
ai.permission.insight_read: See insights: what the detectors found at the hotel and why
ai.setting.insights_recurring_failure: Recurring equipment failure: the window in days and how many corrective repairs raise an insight
ai.setting.insights_sla_cluster: SLA breach cluster: recent and baseline windows in days, minimum breaches and the factor above the baseline
ai.setting.insights_repeat_complaint: Repeat complaints: the window in days and how many complaints per room or category raise an insight
ai.setting.insights_slow_turnaround: Slow turnaround: the window in days, the minimum cleans and the factor above the property's median
ai.insight.reason.recurring_failure: Corrective repairs on this equipment in the last {days} days: {count}.
ai.insight.reason.recurring_failure_same: Corrective repairs on this equipment in the last {days} days: {count}, most with the same cause ({cause}).
ai.insight.reason.sla_breach_cluster: Missed targets in {department} in the last {days} days: {count} (usually about {baseline}).
ai.insight.reason.repeat_complaint_room: Complaints about this room in the last {days} days: {count} (mostly {category}).
ai.insight.reason.repeat_complaint_categ: Complaints about {category} in the last {days} days: {count}.
ai.insight.reason.slow_turnaround: From cleaned to inspected takes {median_minutes} minutes for these rooms, against {property_minutes} for the hotel ({samples} cleans).
ai.insight.action.preventive_check: Plan a preventive check of this equipment.
ai.insight.action.inspect_room: Inspect the room before the next arrival.
ai.insight.action.review_category: Look into what keeps causing {category} complaints.
ai.insight.action.review_inspection_flow: Review how cleaned rooms of this type reach inspection.
ai.insight.action.prepare_arrivals: Go through tomorrow's risky arrivals with housekeeping and engineering.
ai.permission.manager_use: Ask the Manager assistant about the hotel
ai.permission.intelligence_cross_propert: Compare the hotels of the group
